A trava: roda, pergunta ou recusa: The gate: run, ask, or refuse
Um comando de leitura não precisa da mes: A read command doesn’t need the same decision as a command that writes a file. The gate classifies before running; the audit shows what ran and what was refused. The chosen policy changes when the assistant asks: dangerous commands, always, or never.
Identificar as três classes de comando e: Identify the three command classes and check one refused request and one approval request in the audit.
Fotografia editorial que representa a tr: Editorial photography showing the safeguard at work: it runs, asks, or refuses.
Comandos da lista de leitura, como ls, c: Commands on the read-only list, such as ls, cat, and pwd, run with the default dangerous policy.
Qualquer comando fora da lista de leitur: Any command outside the read-only list, or one that writes a file, asks for approval. In the demo, the owner doesn’t approve.
Padrões destrutivos conhecidos, como rm: Known destructive patterns, such as rm -rf / and variants, never run.
A classificação não é uma garantia total: Classification is not a complete guarantee against every unknown command; the sandbox limits what it can reach when you need to run something new.
Só o que está na lista de leitura passa: Only what’s on the read-only list runs directly. Everything else asks for approval; this is safer than a short list of forbidden words.
Na política perigosos (padrão), leitura: With the dangerous policy (default), known read-only commands such as ls or cat run without asking; anything that tries to write asks “run …? [s/N]”. Type n or press Enter to refuse; s approves. With the always policy, it asks before ANY command, even ls and cat. With the never policy, known read-only commands run, but anything that would need approval is refused without asking. A command blocked by the safeguard never runs under any policy.
Pipe é quando você manda texto pronto pa: A pipe is when you send ready-made text to the program instead of typing in the terminal. In that case, the approval request is refused because no one can answer the interactive prompt.
A auditoria imprime uma linha JSON (regi: The audit prints one JSON line (a record with named fields) per event. In the command line, comando is the request; classe is allowed, approval required, or blocked; rodou is true if it ran; decisao explains why. Tool-type lines record the tool used.

✅ já existe e cita o arquivo real, como: ✅ already exists and names the actual file, such as intelecto/canais/telegram.py; 🟡 exists in part and says what’s missing; ➕ doesn’t exist yet and points to the part where the agent can add code.
O .md manda fazer um ingrediente por vez: The .md says to work on one ingredient at a time, write a test in tests/ and run python3 -m pytest -q. It also says to preserve the lock, keep secrets only in the vault, test without a real API, update the process table in README when usage changes, and say “done” only with the test output.
